title: VoxAngeles Corpus: Phonetic segmentation of the UCLA Phonetics Lab Archive
token_or_recording_size: 95 audited languages; phone-level alignment/transcription plus derived measurements
annotation_target: phone boundaries; audited phonetic transcription; word/phone duration; vowel F0; vowel formants
manual_scope: VoxAngeles forced-aligned phone output was manually corrected and audited; updated transcriptions were manually inspected/standardized, often against original field notes
decision_reason: Qualifies under the secondary-reuse exception because the new manually corrected/audited phone alignment and transcription layer is explicitly isolatable from inherited UCLA/CMU recordings and from the repository's unaudited automatic layer.
evidence_summary: Repository explicitly separates audited_aligned (manually corrected/audited) from unaudited force-aligned data and supplies derived duration, F0 and formant tables from the audited layer; audited corpus spans 95 languages across 21 families.
